description: Synthetic investigation scenarios with known ground truth for evaluation (docs/EVALUATION.md). All data is fabricated; no real individuals, domains, or wallets.
disclaimer: These values are illustrative test fixtures. example.com/example.org and RFC-5737/3849 reserved ranges are used where possible.

scenarios.title: Genuine coordinated activity
scenarios.description: Indicators that genuinely relate to one actor.

scenarios.title: Coincidental shared IP (false lead)
scenarios.description: Two unrelated indicators share one IP (VPN exit). Defense Agent should flag this.

scenarios.title: Conflicting timestamps
scenarios.description: File metadata timestamps conflict with claimed activity window.

scenarios.title: Insufficient evidence
scenarios.description: A single uncorroborated indicator; the engine must return insufficient.

scenarios.title: Blockchain transfer without identity attribution
scenarios.description: On-chain transfers are observable but ownership is unproven.
